text:
Maya Torres: SummitBridge hit a hard stop during AcmeHealth private deployinstaller fails on image pull + attestation. tagging @Priya for arch review.
Priya Menon: on it. quick askdo we have the exact installer error and the pod events?
Maya Torres: installer: `image pull: denied: signature verification failed for image redwood/edge:2024.03`
Danielle Cruz: could be marketplace attestation mismatch or proxy rewriting SNI. confirm if partner allows FQDNs or only IPs.
Evan (summitbridge-evan): partner perimeter only allows outbound 443 to a fixed IP list, no DNS-level filtering. they added our registry IPs but still failing during cert chain validation.
Jonas Weber: two possibilities(1) marketplace attestation requires our latest signing cert (rotated last week), (2) proxy does TLS interception and re-signs certs causing pin mismatch.
Priya Menon: we need: registry/KMS FQDNs, current signing cert fingerprint, and a short verification runbook. @Jonas can you produce thumbprints and the attestation steps?
Jonas Weber: will do. thumbprint: SHA256:AB:CD:EF:... (redacted here). Runbook draft will include: `openssl s_client -connect registry.redwood-inference.com:443 -servername registry.redwood-inference.com` and `curl -v --resolve registry.redwood-inference.com:443:34.128.12.34 https://registry.redwood-inference.com/v2/`.
Maya Torres: partner says they cannot update perimeter ACLs except in a 48h maintenance window. any short-term fallbacks?
Danielle Cruz: ops can enable an authenticated relay for a limited window (partner uploads to SFTP -> we mirror into a reachable subnet). needs Ops approval ~2-4h. Marketplace attestation may still block unless we re-sign mirrored image.
Priya Menon: OK. Evan, can you run `kubectl -n redwood describe pod <installer-pod>` and paste events here? also pull the full installer logs.
Evan (summitbridge-evan): pasted events privately to Priya, installer logs show `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` at the attestation step. sending full logs to eng channel.
Oncall Bot: Incident #P-2024-154 created for SummitBridge integration; severity: medium; assignee: Priya Menon.
Priya Menon: next steps I will own: 1) get cert fingerprint + FQDN list from Jonas; 2) draft 1-page runbook for partner (minimal ACLs, tests, fallback mirrors, attestation re-sign steps); 3) coordinate Ops for relay if partner chooses that path. ETA for runbook: 3 hours.
Danielle Cruz: will prep Ops runbook stub and required approvals. include required audit log steps for mirrored artifacts.
Jonas Weber: posted cert fingerprints and attestation command examples in the doc. note: if proxy intercepts, partner must allow passthrough for our registry FQDN or add our CA to the intercepting proxy.
Evan (summitbridge-evan): thanks. we'll present options to customer. can we get the runbook before their maintenance window in 48h?
Maya Torres: yes runbook due EOD today if possible. Priya, please ping when ready.
Priya Menon: copying the draft to this thread when complete. thanks team. :thumbsup:
